shots.prompt: Warm candlelight in the hut, old Earth relics everywhere, the old man pours tea
lines: NARRATOR
His name was Kael. The last guardian.

shots.prompt: He speaks kindly
lines: KAEL
Sit. You're safe here. For tonight.

shots.prompt: Kael lights old lanterns one by one around the hut
lines: NARRATOR
Kael's hut was full of things from a world that no longer existed.
Kael'in kulübesi artık var olmayan bir dünyanın eşyalarıyla doluydu.

shots.prompt: Ryan looks around the hut amazed at old objects, picking up a toy rocket
lines: NARRATOR
Every object was a story. Every story was a warning.
Her eşya bir hikâyeydi. Her hikâye bir uyarı.

shots.prompt: He holds the toy
lines: RYAN
Is this from Earth? The real Earth?

shots.prompt: A dust storm swallows an empty city street
lines: NARRATOR
The year 2099. The sky turned to dust.
Yıl 2099. Gökyüzü toza döndü.

shots.prompt: He nods sadly
lines: KAEL
I was a boy in 2099. I saw it end.

shots.prompt: Grey dying cities, dust storms, people boarding the last rocket
lines: NARRATOR
Earth was dying. A few people escaped to build Elyra in the sky.

shots.prompt: Crowds run toward a launch pad as the rocket engines ignite
lines: NARRATOR
Millions wanted a seat. Only a few found one.
Milyonlar bir yer istedi. Sadece birkaçı buldu.

shots.prompt: The last rocket rises through dust into the stars
She asks quietly
lines: ASHLEY
And the capsules? Why were we sleeping?

shots.prompt: Frost forms and melts on the capsule glass in slow breaths
lines: NARRATOR
Twenty-three children. Twenty-three dreams of a new Earth.
Yirmi üç çocuk. Yeni bir Dünya'nın yirmi üç rüyası.

shots.prompt: He looks at her deeply
lines: KAEL
You twenty-three were Earth's last hope.

shots.prompt: Rows of sleeping capsules in a dark chamber, blue lights pulsing
lines: KAEL
The other twenty-two still sleep beneath the Fortress.

shots.prompt: Sila's guards march in perfect rows, red lights flashing
lines: NARRATOR
Sila had built an army that never slept.
Sila asla uyumayan bir ordu kurmuştu.

shots.prompt: She stands up angrily
lines: AVA
Then Sila is keeping them prisoner.

shots.prompt: A blonde woman in black walks through a red-lit hall, guards bowing
lines: NARRATOR
Sila. Commander of the Shadow. She wanted Elyra for herself.

shots.prompt: Ashley practices with the glowing pendant, light shooting from it
Kael opens an old chest and takes out a glowing green pendant
lines: NARRATOR
Kael had kept one last gift. For this day.
Kael son bir hediye saklamıştı. Bu gün için.

shots.prompt: He offers the pendant
lines: KAEL
This opens any door. And any mind.

shots.prompt: Ava sharpens the tip of her staff by the fire
lines: NARRATOR
Nobody slept much that night.
O gece kimse pek uyuyamadı.

shots.prompt: Ashley takes the pendant, it glows brightly in her hand
She looks at the glow
lines: ASHLEY
Then we go tomorrow. All of us.

shots.prompt: Shooting stars cross the night sky over the islands
The cat curls up on a blanket by the fire, helmet slipping
Ryan falls asleep against Ava's shoulder, smiling
lines: NARRATOR
For one night, they were almost a family.

shots.prompt: Ava gently covers Ryan with a blanket and looks at the stars
lines: NARRATOR
Ava had never had a family. Now she was protecting one.
Ava'nın hiç ailesi olmamıştı. Şimdi bir aileyi koruyordu.

shots.prompt: Ashley stands outside at night, holding the green pendant, stars above
lines: NARRATOR
Ashley made a promise to the stars. She would bring them all home.
Ashley yıldızlara bir söz verdi. Hepsini eve getirecekti.

shots.prompt: The fortress in the dark, a red searchlight sweeping the clouds
The pale twin watches from a distant rooftop, red eyes in the dark
lines: SHADOW
Tomorrow, Twenty-Three. Tomorrow I become you.

shots.prompt: Dawn breaks over the floating islands
The group sets off at dawn across a bridge, Kael leading
lines: NARRATOR
The Fortress was waiting.
